editionLabel: SimplyFun English rules linked from product SKU SF070
firstPlayerRule: After everyone receives eight tiles, each player or team reveals its lowest number tile. The player or team with the lowest number goes first.
officialTieBreak: If tied, reveal the second-lowest number, continuing through the tiles until the tie is resolved.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The manual permits up to four individuals or two teams of two or more; apply the comparison to the players or teams in your game.
The starter must form a valid equation using the = tile already in the middle. Play then continues clockwise.
